data.name: Agent Versus
data.detailed_description:
📢 Get your party ready for an online Social Deduction game for 2–8 players! Step into the role of a Special Agent in a thrilling showdown between two sides:

           🔹 Spies who must blend in with NPCs and complete secret missions.

           🔹 Detectives who must expose the Spies hiding among the crowd.

      🕵️‍♂️ Sharpen your skills to act natural and outsmart the Detectives or use your eagle eyes to hunt down the Spies.

      🔫 When Spies and Detectives collide, the real game begins in AGENT VERSUS! 🎮

      👓 Disguise! Blend in as one of 12 NPC characters and copy their behaviors as naturally as possible. Don’t let the Detectives notice anything odd.

      👓 Do Missions! Check the top-right corner for active tasks. Follow the orange highlights on the map to complete objectives.

      👥 Team Up! Every successful mission gives your team +1 point. Green names = your allies!

⚠️ Warning: If you’re caught while transporting items, that mission round is void and a teammate must restart it.

      📌 Pick a Tool! Choose 1 gadget each round to help expose spies.

🧰 Custom Taser

🧰 Custom Sensor

🧰 Disguise Kit

🧰 Baton

⚠️ Be careful: Wrong guesses give the Spies extra points!

      🔎 Watch Closely! Follow NPCs, study behaviors, and look for suspicious moves.

      🙋 Vote! When the round ends, discuss and pick 1 suspect to eliminate.

⚠️ Wrong votes = points for the Spies. If votes tie, the system randomly picks among the tied suspects.

      🔎 Report! Found missing or tampered items? Hit report to start an immediate vote.

     

      🤠 8 unique Detective character options.

      🕺 Fun emotes for both sides, each with unique animations.

      👍 Flexible room settings to fit your party style: choose maps, round times, number of spies, number of missions, and more!

      🔫 Detectives: Miss your mark? Enter PVP mode. Arm up and eliminate every Spy. 

      🔸Miss your shot at exposing all the spies? It’s revenge time! Enter PVP mode, draw your pistol, and gun down the spies to claim victory.

      🆚 Spies: Missions complete? Unlock deadly weapons and turn the hunt around.

      🔸Hit the mission score limit and the game flips. Your team unlocks stronger weapons and gets the chance to hunt the Detectives instead. Stay alive, strike back, and turn the tables!

🕵️‍♂️ Ready to bluff, deceive, and outplay your friends?

     Unmask the Spy in AGENT VERSUS. ( -_•)▄︻テحكـ━一💥

data.short_description: Agent Versus is an online party social deduction game for 2–8 players! Play as special agents with one team on a sercet mission, the other trying to stop them. Blend into the crowds, Spot impostors, and test your wits in the chaotic Spy vs Detective action of Agent Versus. 🕵️
data.supported_languages: English, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i5-9600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1050Ti / RX 5600 XT 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X ／ Intel Core i5-12600K
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 12 GB / RX 6700 XT 12GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
